key_insight: LEAP combines a perovskite-focused LLM with active learning to prioritize precursor additives in a closed loop, making additive discovery more mechanism-aware and data-efficient.
engineering_relevance: The framework can shorten experimental screening cycles for perovskite solar cells by ranking candidates with uncertainty-aware, literature-grounded descriptors before lab testing.
method: Trains a domain-specialized LLM on perovskite additive literature to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge.
Encodes candidate molecules with interpretable descriptors derived from the literature.
Feeds those descriptors into Bayesian optimization with expert feasibility review for iterative prioritization.
evidence_signal: On unseen literature, the specialized model outperformed general-purpose models in mechanism-consistent reasoning, and proof-of-concept screening across three rounds yielded average PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% versus 19.25% for the control, with a champion device reaching 21.32%.
watch_item: The results are promising but still depend on expert-in-the-loop review and a limited proof-of-concept dataset, so broader validation is needed before general deployment.
paper_title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
